_comment: Study 2 (A28 §4) per-token prices, USD per 1,000,000 tokens, standard (non-batch, non-priority) tier, as PUBLISHED by each vendor on the retrieval date. Looked up 2026-10-11 by fetching the vendor's own pricing page. A model missing from this table cannot be run by run-native.ts: its cost could not be computed, and a price is never guessed. inputPerMTok applies to UNCACHED input; cachedInputPerMTok to cache-hit input; outputPerMTok to output INCLUDING reasoning/thinking tokens (all three vendors bill reasoning as output). Where a vendor has a long-context tier, `longContext` gives the threshold (input tokens of ONE call) above which the long rates apply to that call.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Published as '$0.75 through December 31, 2026. $1.50 starting January 1, 2027' (output $3.75 -> $7.50). The study runs before 2027, so the 2026 price applies.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: Same 2026 promotional price as gemini-3.8-flash; doubles on 2027-01-01.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: Study 3 (added 2026-10-15; Study 2 rows keep the top-level 2026-10-11 retrieval date). Published rows, verbatim: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 (for prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | $0.10 / MTok | $0.125 / MTok [5m cache writes] | $0.20 / MTok [1h cache writes] | $0.01 / MTok [cache hits] | $0.50 / MTok' and '(for prompts over 100,000 tokens) | $0.50 | $0.625 | $1 | $0.05 | $2.50'. 'A request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced on its own.' Global routing (no inference_geo), standard tier. Thinking tokens are output tokens. cacheWritePerMTok is the 5-minute rate; the harness requests no caching.

meta/muse-glimmer-30b.note: Study 5 (added 2026-10-15): the pinned endpoint's price from OpenRouter's live /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints, USD per token x 1e6. OpenRouter also returns usage.cost per call; the harness logs it and budgets on the larger of it and this computed cost.
